blocks.content:
All three review comments on [intent-hq/cloudlands-fe#1192](https://github.com/intent-hq/cloudlands-fe/pull/1192) are addressed, pushed, replied to, and resolved:

1. **Single-pass bucketing** — `collectUnreadCycleEntries` now classifies each attention entry exactly once and pushes it into one of three bucket arrays, eliminating the up-to-3x `sessionAttentionPriority` / `derivePendingQuestions` re-derivation:

2. **Within-bucket order test** — added "agents in the same bucket keep the workspace walk order": two blockers and two questions interleaved across ws-1..ws-4, asserting the walk visits b-1 (ws-2), b-2 (ws-4), q-1 (ws-1), q-2 (ws-3).

3. **Formatting nit** — reverted the `nextLayoutPreset` reflow to its exact main-branch form; the function no longer appears in the PR diff (verified with `git diff main`).

**Verification** (from `packages/cloudlands-fe/`): targeted vitest on action-key-registry + agent-cycle tests — 86/86 passed; `pnpm run check` — 0 errors; `pnpm tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` — clean; `pnpm run lint` — passed.

**Wrap-up**: committed as `10c53651f` (`refactor(hardware-console): address PR review on unread-cycle reorder`) and pushed to `feat/unread-cycle-attention-priority`; replied to each inline comment referencing the fix commit and resolved all 3 review threads via GraphQL (`resolved=true` confirmed for each). Reported to the coordinator — CI on the new push and the merge are left to them.
